idea-plugin.name: Age Gate Lint
idea-plugin.description:
8 rules for Ofcom's highly effective age assurance duty, in force since 25 July 2025, where the penalty ceiling is £18m (£18 million) or 10% of qualifying worldwide revenue. One sample vape storefront page returned 13 findings, 10 of them high severity.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Age Gate Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 8 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/age-gate-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/age-gate-lint

action.text: Age Gate Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Age Gate Lint on the file in the editor
